name: Brought Back

abilities.text: Choose up to two target permanent cards in your graveyard that were put there from the battlefield this turn. Return them to the battlefield tapped.

notes: 'Up to two target permanent cards in your graveyard' is the documented return-from-graveyard idiom (target, count 2, optional), with 'permanent card' written as the filter 'not an instant or sorcery card'. APPROXIMATION: no Filter field records how a card reached the graveyard, so 'that were put there from the battlefield this turn' is not restricted. The low round-trip score is a renderer gap: render.ts prints neither 'count' nor 'optional' for return-from-graveyard, so the rendering drops the 'up to two' the line prints.
